text: Quick question—what exactly do we need to include when we kick off the NPI process? I know there’s a checklist somewhere but can’t remember all the bits.

Hey Tom, yeah, it’s in the handbook but basically you need to cover what we’re launching (like features or services), why we’re doing it (the value prop and some financial reasoning), who it’s for (target market/ICP), when we want to launch (any timing stuff), and that we’re actually ready to go (dev is far enough along and GTM has bandwidth).
Awesome, thanks Sara! That’s super helpful. I’ll dig up the handbook page too just to double check.
No problem! Let me know if you need the link, I have it bookmarked somewhere.
